method: Per-quote whitespace-normalised verbatim search over the 2026-07-01 full-run partition file union. Tiers: strict = full quote found OR both 8-word head+tail fragments found; partial = exactly one 8-word end-fragment found verbatim (source region present, quote mutated by extraction); none = no verbatim evidence. A leaf holds the weakest tier of its quotes; a candidate holds the strongest tier of its supporting leaves. quoteModeTally is PER-QUOTE (174 grounding quotes across 167 leaves). Probe window file lists were never conserved, so a strict window-file-set subset check is not computable. Corpus-stability argument: the corpus was 100 files at the v1 run (2026-06-29, per its committed report), the probe ran 2026-06-30, and the 2026-07-01 full-run partition is the same 100 files spanning the same 2026-02-16..2026-06-29 range with full map coverage - the full run read the entire corpus family the probe sampled.
